title: Active Recovery & Mobility Session

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly through full range, focus on spinal articulation

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Control the transition, sit tall with engaged core

items.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization
items.cues: Drive knee forward over toes, hold briefly at end range

items.name: Rowing Machine
items.cues: Easy conversational pace, focus on smooth technique and rhythm

items.name: Adductor Rockbacks
items.cues: Rock back slowly, feel stretch in adductors and hips

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Hold for 3 seconds each rep, maintain neutral spine

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold static stretch, keep heel down and leg straight

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Gentle stretch, turn body away from wall slowly

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Slow, meditative movements to finish session

rationale: Recovery session designed to promote blood flow and mobility after extended training break, preparing body for upcoming Vasaloppet training
Low-intensity rowing targets aerobic base development crucial for 90km race while maintaining easy RPE 3-4 intensity
Emphasis on hip and ankle mobility to address key movement patterns needed for cross-country skiing technique
